dependency_evidence: Original predeclared literature interpretation: European Chiastocheta, including C. rotundiventris, exclusively and obligatorily reproduce in T. europaeus fruits; this historical declaration is preserved but is invalidated for downstream use by later adversarial host-scope review.
witness_selection_rule: Freeze exactly twelve Table-1 sites with C. rotundiventris sample count R>0: AMB, BAY, BID, BON, CCO, CDV, CHA, CHE, CRA, CTP, DON, EPO. Use printed coordinates directly; do not add later sites, geocode locality names, or use snapshot information.
host_range_authority: Kew Plants of the World Online 2026: Trollius europaeus accepted; native range Europe to W. Siberia.
known_boundary: Adversarial literature review found C. rotundiventris larvae developing on Trollius altaicus and Trollius asiaticus, two predeclared replacement hosts. The declared species-level exclusive dependency on T. europaeus therefore cannot support downstream testing. No controls were replaced, the dependency scope was not narrowed, and snapshot taxonomy identity/occurrence/model/invariant/knockout layers remain unopened.
